name: memlens
description: See where your C and C++ variables live, how big they are and how structs are padded, live as you type. Flags leaks, double frees and mismatched deletes, and shows real addresses while debugging.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Static analysis works in Restricted Mode. A custom layout compiler and extra flags require a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: MemLens needs files on disk to run the layout compiler.

commands.title: Show Symbol at Cursor in Memory View
Reorder Struct Fields to Remove Padding

memlens.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Path to a `clang` binary used for **exact** struct layouts (`-fdump-record-layouts`). Leave empty to use `clang` from `PATH`. Without a compiler, MemLens estimates layouts from a built-in size table and labels them *estimated*.

memlens.extraFlags.markdownDescription: Extra compiler flags for layout extraction, for example `["-std=c++20", "-Iinclude"]`. When empty, flags come from `compile_commands.json` if one is found.

memlens.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show MemLens findings (possible leaks, double frees, mismatched `delete`, dangling references, padding) as squiggles and in the Problems panel.

enumDescriptions: Only definite mistakes (double free, mismatched delete)
Also possible leaks, use-after-free and dangling references
memlens.diagnostics.minSeverity.description: Lowest severity reported in the Problems panel.

memlens.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show `sizeof` and padding above each struct, class and union, with a one-click fix when reordering fields would shrink it.

memlens.hover.enabled.description: Show size, lifetime and field layout when hovering a variable or type.

memlens.followCursor.description: Select the block under the editor cursor in the memory view.

memlens.preferDebuggerSnapshots.markdownDescription: While a C or C++ debug session is paused, show the live frame (real addresses and pointer targets) in the memory view. Works with the Microsoft C++ debugger (`cppdbg`, `cppvsdbg`) and CodeLLDB.

enumDescriptions: Okabe–Ito colours, readable with common colour-vision deficiencies
memlens.themePalette.description: Colours used for stack, heap and global regions in the memory view.

memlens.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after you stop typing before the file is re-analyzed.

memlens.historyLength.description: Number of snapshots kept per file for the history scrubber.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with MemLens
walkthroughs.description: See memory layout and lifetime problems in your C and C++ code as you type.

steps.title: Open the memory view
steps.description:
Open any C or C++ file, then click the MemLens icon in the editor title bar (or press Ctrl+Alt+M).
[Open Memory View](command:memlens.openView)

steps.title: Shrink a struct
steps.description: Look for the sizeof / padding line above each struct. When reordering would save bytes, click it or use the quick fix (Ctrl+.).

steps.title: Catch lifetime bugs
steps.description:
Possible leaks, double frees, mismatched new[]/delete and dangling references appear as squiggles and in the Problems panel.
[Open Problems](command:workbench.actions.view.problems)

steps.title: See the live frame while debugging
steps.description: Start a C or C++ debug session and pause at a breakpoint. MemLens switches to the live frame with real addresses and pointer targets.

steps.title: Optional: exact layouts with clang
steps.description:
Without a compiler MemLens estimates layouts. Point it at clang for compiler-verified offsets.
[Set Compiler Path](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22memlens.compilerPath%22)

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=out/extension.js --sourcemap && esbuild ../analysis/dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/analysis.worker.js --sourcemap && npm run build:webview-res
scripts.build:release: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=out/extension.js && esbuild ../analysis/dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/analysis.worker.js && npm run build:webview-res
scripts.test: npm run test:build && npm run compile && node --test "out-test/test/extension.test.js"
